title: Biostatistics with R
text:
1 Biostatistics with R
Welcome to Biostatistics with R, an online learning resource designed to introduce the principles and practice of biostatistics using R.
This book is intended for students, researchers, and health professionals who want to develop practical skills in understanding, analyzing, and presenting health and medical research data.

title: Biostatistics with R
text:
1.1 What you will learn
Throughout this book, you will learn how to:

Understand different types of data used in medical research
Summarize and visualize data
Understand probability and statistical distributions
Conduct inferential statistical analyses
Understand study designs and sampling methods
Select and apply appropriate statistical tests
Build and interpret regression models
Analyze survival data
Evaluate diagnostic tests
Handle missing data
Report statistical results clearly
Conduct reproducible analyses using R

The examples throughout the book will use R and RStudio, with an emphasis on practical applications in medical and health research.

title: Biostatistics with R
text: When we conduct studies, we draw a sample from the population, and the results represent only the sample we have drawn. It is almost impossible and expensive to study the entire population. However, we need to know how these results reflect what is happening in the population. Let us think a scenario, where researcher have 3,000 people as study sample representing Rwamagana District in Rwanda. We know that Rwamagana District has an estimated population of 577, 439 in 2026. How can the results of the sample representing this population represent what happening in the population.
